channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Cheers To 2026 Olympic Hockey: Are You Not Entertained?
item.description: The 2026 Olympic men's hockey tournament featured thrilling games, unexpected upsets and dominant performances that captivated fans. No matter which country you were pulling for to win gold, you had to be a fan of the caliber of the games we saw.

item.title: These Olympics Were The Redemption Games For Auston Matthews, J.T. Miller And So Many More
item.description: Whether it was OT hero Jack Hughes proving he can be a big-game star or goalie Connor Hellebuyck showing that he can win when the stakes are the highest or even J.T. Miller proving that he is a penalty-killing stud — not a dressing room pariah — the Olympics helped erase a lot of narratives.

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck's Gold Medal Game Was 'An All-Time Performance From A Superstar' For Team USA
item.description: Heading into the gold medal game, Connor Hellebuyck felt he was doing everything right. And did it ever translate, with his Team USA teammates describing his play as a generational performance.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Bruins Could Be Deadline Buyers, Blue Jackets Face Decisions With Pending UFAs
item.description: The Boston Bruins could attempt to bolster their blueline by the NHL trade deadline. Meanwhile, the Columbus Blue Jackets must decide if they'll re-sign or shop their UFA-eligible players.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Recapping A Memorable Olympics
item.description: Ryan Kennedy, Michael Traikos and Andrew McInnis break down Canada and the USA's tournaments, share some stories from Milan and much more.

item.title: 2026 NHL Draft Rankings: Ferrari's February Top 64 Has Stenberg Above McKenna
item.description: NHL draft expert Tony Ferrari shares his top 64 prospects with in-depth analysis of the top 32, including a group of four prospects in consideration for first overall.

item.title: Trading A Right Winger Could Do The Philadelphia Flyers A Lot Of Good
item.description: The Philadelphia Flyers have a surplus of right wingers, which means they could use one or more as trade bait to address gaps elsewhere in the lineup.

item.title: Team USA's Love For Johnny Gaudreau Brings Tears To His High School Family
item.description: The principal of the high school Johnny and Matthew Gaudreau attended said Team USA honoring the brothers after they won gold blew him away. And the students took notice as well.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In The NHL: Raymond, Armia And More Impressed At The Olympics
item.description: Which players who weren't among the all-star honorees had a stellar Olympics? And who wasn't close to meeting expectations?

item.title: Goodbye To The Gretzky Of Minor Pro Hockey
item.description: Guyle Fielder was one of the top scorers in professional hockey history, up there with Wayne Gretzky and Gordie Howe. He did the bulk of his scoring with Seattle in the old Western Hockey League.
